editorial.blurb: A beautifully decorated neighborhood gem serving authentic Mexican cuisine with generous portions, vibrant salsas, and the kind of care that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Judge the kitchen by the complimentary chips and salsas—here they're perfect—then order the Tostadas with Shrimp; go for a late weekday lunch to avoid waits.

topDishes.note: Crispy tortilla, chewy shrimp, onions and cilantro in perfect harmony
Generous portions of big, juicy shrimp
